appearance.extreme: Their hands are paddles, webbed nearly to the fingertips and veined pink. They hold a glass in their whole palm.
appearance.obvious: Translucent webbing runs to the first knuckle of every finger.
appearance.subtle: The skin between their fingers runs a little high.

description: Skin has grown between your fingers, most of the way to the tips. Excellent in water. Awkward everywhere else.
name: Webbed Fingers
